name: Timm Lauser
biography: Timm Lauser received his masters degree in computers science from Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Germany in 2020. Since then, he is a PhD student at Darmstadt University of Applied Sciences, Germany. There, he is researching in the field of automotive cyber security with a focus on communication protocols and their formal verification in the symbolic model.
